market.question: Will George Russell be the 2026 F1 Drivers' Champion?

assessment.reasoning: After early 2026 races (Australia, China, Japan), Russell sits 2nd ~9 pts behind teammate Antonelli, with 22 races still to come. Mercedes is the dominant car this season but he's currently not the points leader. Title is wide open: Antonelli, Russell, plus Ferrari (Leclerc/Hamilton) and Red Bull (Verstappen) all in play. With ~5-6 plausible contenders, base-rate ~20%; he's stronger than average so ~22%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether Antonelli sustains his form or Russell pulls ahead; reliability and Verstappen recovery.
